newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trade bids for 942,000 T EU wheat to Africa - ONIC.
newsitem.headline: Trade bids for 942,000 T EU wheat to Africa - ONIC.

text.p: EU grain exporters applied through France to export a total of 942,000 tonnes of soft wheat to a target group of African nations under licences carrying a 28 Ecu per tonne rebate, France's grain office ONIC said on Friday.

Applications for 800,000 tonnes were made under a long-term export scheme and for 142,000 tonnes under a short-term scheme launched by the EU on Thursday to provide special relief for traditional African customers, it said.
The 28-Ecu refund is 10 Ecus higher than the refund awarded this week for ordinary wheat exports to non-EU importing countries.

Under the short-term scheme traders apply for licences valid for nearly five months without having to show contracts in advance. The Commission has three working days to reject or accept these applications.
Under the longer-term scheme operators apply for licences valid until June 30. But they must show proof of the contracts to receive their export rebates.
